visual_elements.description: One-level hierarchy/tree diagram. ROOT NODE: black rectangle containing three centered lines of yellow bold text: 'Major Domains' / 'of' / 'Machine/Deep  Learning' (note: double space between 'Machine/Deep' and 'Learning'). CHILD NODES (four equal rectangles in a row): (1) blue rectangle, white bold text 'Time Series' on one line; (2) green rectangle, white bold text 'Computer Vision' on two lines ('Computer' / 'Vision'); (3) brown rectangle, white bold text 'Speech' on one line; (4) dark-red rectangle, white bold text 'Natural Language Processing' on three lines ('Natural' / 'Language' / 'Processing'). CONNECTORS: four thin red curved arrows, all originating from a single point at the bottom-center of the root node, curving outward — leftmost arrow curves far left down to top-center of 'Time Series'; second arrow curves slightly left down to 'Computer Vision'; third curves slightly right down to 'Speech'; rightmost curves far right down to 'Natural Language Processing'. All arrowheads point downward at the child boxes.

Draw four child rectangles in one row at ~60%-81% height, each with bold white centered text ~22pt: (a) blue #1F1FA8 box at ~9%-28% width, text 'Time Series'; (b) green #1E8A4E box at ~31%-49% width, text 'Computer Vision' wrapped as 'Computer'/'Vision'; (c) brown #7B4A12 box at ~53%-71% width, text 'Speech'; (d) dark-red #A51515 box at ~74%-92% width, text 'Natural Language Processing' wrapped as 'Natural'/'Language'/'Processing'. 8. Add four curved red (#C00000) elbow/curve connectors, each starting from the single bottom-center point of the black title box and ending with a downward arrowhead at the top-center of each child box, fanning symmetrically left and right. 9.
